items.title: Odoo and Nextcloud
items.summary: Your business management and your shared files, on open-source software. Installed on your premises, with us or in the cloud.
items.lead: I install, adapt and maintain Odoo and Nextcloud. You choose where they run, and your data stays yours.

sections.title: Odoo, to run your business
sections.text: Customers, quotes, sales, invoices, purchases, stock, projects: one piece of software, with one app for each need. We start with what is really useful to you, and add the rest later.

sections.title: Nextcloud, for your files and your team
sections.text: Your shared documents, calendars and contacts, on computer and phone, with chat and video calls for the team. Like the big online services, but on a server you choose.

sections.title: Where they run
list: On your premises: on a server installed in your own offices. Your staff on site keep working when the internet is down.
With us: on a server rented and maintained by Chantrea Systems, in [À COMPLÉTER PAR STEFAN : pays].
In the cloud: with a large hosting provider, on an account in your name.
In every case, you know which country your data is in.

sections.title: Modules made for you
sections.text: When the software does not do what you need, I build a custom module: a report, an invoice in your format, a link with another piece of software. I first check whether an existing module already does the job: that costs you less.

sections.title: Maintenance
list: A backup every night, copied to a second location, and regular restore tests.
Security updates.
Moving to new versions, prepared and tested beforehand.
Help for your users.
Plans and prices: [À COMPLÉTER PAR STEFAN]

sections.title: Good to know
list: Odoo comes in a free version and a paid version. I tell you honestly whether the free version is enough for you.
Odoo releases a new version every year: plan for an upgrade every two or three years.
Your data stays yours. If you change provider, you get a full copy and the access details.

items.trademarks: Odoo and Nextcloud are trademarks of their respective owners.

items.title: Artificial intelligence
items.summary: Adding AI to the tools you already use. Only where it really saves you time.
items.lead: AI can save time on repetitive tasks. I add it to your current tools, without changing everything.

sections.title: A few possible examples
list: Drafting answers to your customers' frequent questions.
Translating texts between Khmer, English, French and other languages.
Summarizing or sorting documents and emails.
Pulling information out of invoices or forms.

sections.title: How I do it
list: We start small, with a single task.
You stay in control: the AI suggests, a person decides.
I tell you honestly what AI does badly, and what it costs.

sections.title: AI that stays on your premises
sections.text: With Ollama, open AI models run on a server installed on your premises. Your documents do not go out on the internet.

sections.title: The hardware
sections.text: A server or a computer with a graphics card, chosen for the task and the number of users. I tell you what you really need.

sections.title: Good to know
list: Quality varies between languages, Khmer in particular: we test on your documents before deciding.
An AI installed on your premises is less powerful than the biggest online services.
The server needs an air-conditioned room and a UPS.

items.title: Infrastructure
items.summary: Setup of servers, networks, Wi-Fi and UPS units, cabling, Windows and Linux, virtualization with XCP-ng and XenServer.
items.lead: From choosing the hardware to maintenance, I look after your installation from start to finish.

sections.title: The hardware
sections.text: Servers, switches, firewalls, Wi-Fi, UPS units and backup storage. New hardware, bought from the official distributors in Cambodia, with the manufacturer's warranty. I choose what fits your size, not the most expensive.

sections.title: The cabling
sections.text: The cabling is done by installers I choose and supervise. Every socket is tested and labelled. You receive the plan of your network.

sections.title: Windows and Linux
sections.text: Setup, updates and troubleshooting of workstations and servers, on Windows as well as Linux.

sections.title: Virtualization with XCP-ng and XenServer
sections.text: Several virtual servers on one physical machine, managed from a web browser with Xen Orchestra: less hardware to buy, simpler backups, faster recovery after a failure. I also maintain existing XenServer servers, and I migrate your machines from VMware.

sections.title: On your premises, with us or in the cloud
sections.text: Your virtual servers can run on your premises, on servers rented by Chantrea Systems, or with a large hosting provider.

sections.title: How it works
list: A visit of your premises.
A detailed quote: hardware, cabling and labour listed separately.
Ordering the hardware, then installation.
Handover of the documents: network plan, list of hardware, warranties.

sections.text: Regular follow-up, updates, and a call-out when something breaks down. Plans and prices: [À COMPLÉTER PAR STEFAN]

angkor.title: Angkor World Engine
angkor.lead: The Angkor and Siem Reap region rebuilt in 3D at real scale, from open geographic data. One metre on screen is a real metre: a journey takes as long as it really would. Fly over it or drive through it.

about.lead: I'm Stefan, founder of Chantrea Systems, based in Kampot, Cambodia.

sections.title: Why "Chantrea"
sections.text: Chantrea means "moonlight" in Khmer. A calm light that illuminates without dazzling. That is what I want to bring to your tools.

sections.title: You talk directly to me
